argument_markdown:
## Source-backed inputs

ATT-0065, confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109, identifies the intrinsic balanced evaluation-failure Fitting scheme with relative triviality of ω⊗W_5^∨(Γ), and identifies the ambient scheme under its explicit equation-bundle base-change hypothesis (CLM-0065-4 and CLM-0065-9). ATT-0066, confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116, supplies the reduced h⁰-strata, the projective-bundle model for the Abel–Jacobi incidence, and the unreduced stack-level S_6-torsor with scheme-theoretic evaluation-locus identification on Conf_6 (CLM-0066-3 through CLM-0066-6). Its qualifications are retained: B_4 may be nonempty, reduced support need not occur on every fibre, and the projective-bundle statement is not promoted across nonreduced or jumping bases.

## Proved steps

1. Write E_k=π_*L|_{B_k}. By the verified H3 statement, E_k is locally free of rank k and I_k≅P(E_k^∨). If Y is an irreducible component of B_k, then P(E_k^∨|_Y) is irreducible because it is Zariski-locally Y×P^{k-1}. It is a maximal irreducible closed subset of I_k. Conversely, the image of any irreducible component of I_k is contained in an irreducible component Y of B_k, so the component lies in P(E_k^∨|_Y). This proves the component bijection. The projective-bundle dimension formula gives dim(Y)+k−1. The specialization dim(Y)=15 and k=3 gives 17; subtracting from dim M_{6,6}=21 gives only the numerical difference four.

2. By CLM-0066-6, I_tilde→I^{dist} is an S_6-torsor before any unilateral reduction, and I_tilde equals Z_ev scheme-theoretically on the ordered disjoint-section locus. CLM-0065-4 and CLM-0065-9 provide the intrinsic and, under the stated ambient hypotheses, ambient Fitting-scheme interpretation. No assertion is made outside the distinct-support scope.

3. Fix a connected component X and a geometric base point. A principal S_6-torsor has fibre the regular S_6-set. Its étale monodromy acts by left multiplication through a subgroup H_X⊂S_6. Connected components of the cover correspond to H_X-orbits in this regular set. Every orbit has |H_X| elements, so there are 720/|H_X| components, each of degree |H_X|. Transitivity is equivalent to H_X=S_6. This classifies the finite-cover behavior without asserting the missing full-monodromy theorem.

4. An automorphism of an unordered divisor acts on its set of orderings. After choosing x_tilde this gives Aut(x)→S_6. Its kernel consists exactly of automorphisms preserving every label, namely Aut(x_tilde), proving exactness. Suppose now that three marked images in P¹ are distinct and one marked point p is étale for γ. An ordered automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation fixing the three images, hence the identity. It is therefore a deck transformation fixing p. Near (p,p), the first projection C×_{P¹}C→C is étale; its identity and deck-transformation sections that agree at p agree on a neighbourhood. Since C is geometrically connected and smooth, equality on this nonempty open forces equality globally. Thus the ordered automorphism is the identity. This local argument does not assume that p lies over the globally unbranched base locus.

## Computational hypotheses

None. The arithmetic 15+2=17 and 21−17=4 is bookkeeping only and is not used to establish a universal base dimension, closed image, or codimension theorem.

## Remaining gaps

The theorem leaves open irreducibility and dimensions of the balanced-base components, occurrence of distinct-support divisors on every component, full S_6 monodromy, global stabilizer triviality, stack descent of H3, and all forgetful-map, lci, Gysin, Hodge, and Tate assertions.

claims.justification: ATT-0066/CLM-0066-4 and CLM-0066-5, confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116, give the projectivization of a rank-k vector bundle; irreducibility and dimension follow Zariski-locally from Y×P^{k-1}.
claims.statement: On each reduced constant-h⁰ stratum B_k, irreducible components of the Abel–Jacobi incidence correspond bijectively to irreducible components Y of B_k and have dimension dim(Y)+k−1.

claims.justification: CLM-0089-1 gives 15+2=17. The claim explicitly does not promote the arithmetic to a closed-image, purity, or Gysin statement.
claims.statement: A 15-dimensional B_3 component has a 17-dimensional incidence component; its dimension differs numerically by four from dim M_{6,6}=21.

claims.justification: ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6 with REV-0110 and REV-0116 supplies the torsor and ordered scheme equality; ATT-0065/CLM-0065-4 and CLM-0065-9 with REV-0108 and REV-0109 supplies the intrinsic and ambient Fitting interpretation.
claims.statement: The ordered distinct-support incidence is an unreduced stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor of degree 720 and equals the evaluation-failure scheme on Conf_6 in the verified intrinsic and conditional ambient scopes.

claims.justification: Finite étale covers are classified by the monodromy action on a geometric fibre; for a principal S_6-torsor this is the regular S_6-set, whose H_X-orbits all have cardinality |H_X|.
claims.statement: Over a connected component X of I^{dist}, if H_X is the torsor monodromy image in S_6, the ordered cover has 720/|H_X| connected components, each of degree |H_X|; it is connected exactly for full S_6 monodromy.

claims.justification: The kernel of the action on orderings fixes every label. Three target images kill the induced PGL_2 transformation, and an over-P¹ automorphism fixing an étale point agrees locally, hence globally, with the identity.
claims.statement: For an ordered lift x_tilde of an unordered distinct divisor x, 1→Aut(x_tilde)→Aut(x)→S_6 is exact; on the locus with three distinct target images and an étale marked point, Aut(x_tilde) is trivial.

summary: The verified Abel–Jacobi geometry determines the incidence components and their relative dimensions on each reduced h⁰-stratum. The ordered distinct-support locus is a degree-720 stack-level torsor whose connected components are exactly controlled by the still-unknown monodromy image. Stabilizers fit into the permutation representation, with trivial ordered stabilizer on the stated rigid locus. The lemma does not claim irreducibility, full monodromy, closed-image geometry, or Tate consequences.

theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero and B a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let π:C→B be smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, and let γ:C→P¹_B be a finite flat degree-four cover with fibrewise balanced Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle O(4)⊕O(5), the canonical filtration with degree-16 quotient W_5, and the weak relative-canonical normalization assumed in ATT-0066. Put L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}, let B_k={b∈B:h⁰(L_b)=k} for k∈{3,4}, equipped with their reduced locally closed structures, and let I=Hilb⁶(C/B)×_{Pic⁶(C/B)}B be the Abel–Jacobi incidence of L. Then: (1) I_k:=I×_B B_k is a P^{k-1}-bundle over B_k. Its irreducible components correspond bijectively to those of B_k; the component over an irreducible component Y⊂B_k has dimension dim(Y)+k-1. In particular, a 15-dimensional component of B_3 gives a 17-dimensional incidence component, and 21−17=4 is only the numerical ambient dimension difference, not a closed-image or Gysin assertion. (2) Let I^{dist} be the open locus of divisors with six distinct support points and let I_tilde=Conf_6(C/B)×_{Hilb⁶(C/B)}I. Without reducing either side, I_tilde→I^{dist} is a finite étale S_6-torsor of degree 720 at stack level. On Conf_6 it is scheme-theoretically the intrinsic evaluation-failure locus; it is also the ambient balanced CE evaluation-failure locus when the additional ambient freeness and arbitrary-base-change hypotheses of ATT-0065 hold. (3) For every connected component X of I^{dist}, let H_X⊂S_6 be the image of the monodromy representation of this torsor. Then I_tilde×_{I^{dist}}X has exactly 720/|H_X| connected components, each finite étale of degree |H_X| over X. Thus it is connected exactly when H_X=S_6. (4) For a geometric point x of I^{dist} and a chosen ordering x_tilde above it, the action on the ordering fibre gives an exact sequence of geometric automorphism groups 1→Aut(x_tilde)→Aut(x)→S_6, where the last map records the induced permutation and need not be surjective. On the locus where the ordered marked points have at least three distinct images in P¹ and at least one marked point is étale for γ, Aut(x_tilde)=1; hence Aut(x) injects into S_6 there.
